notes: Analysis reports with invoices (B2B and B2C) now work like sample dispatches: one PDF per grade, named by the grade (e.g. Y300 MESH.pdf); items without a report template are left out. New rule everywhere: items of one invoice / dispatch with the same item group (or same item) and the same colour get one report, for the first such item; same group with another colour gets its own report.
